Findings round — **promoted**: `finding` → `pm:queue`, with an explicit scope split.

- **Queueable scope = the two typo groups only**: es `Done` — three sites `Listo` vs `grid.bulk.done` `Hecho` (`es.ts:107/:174/:316/:759`, re-verified @ `99ba5fb`); de `Loading...` — `common.loading` `Wird geladen...` (`de.ts:69`) vs `Laden...` (`:806`). Same-context strings, no grammatical divergence; a two-value fix plus the affected REUSED/pin lists.
- **The denominator record stays on-card as documentation**: 281 shared en strings, 164 with a legitimately divergent translation in at least one locale — a same-en-same-translation gate would emit 164 false reds. That half is knowledge, not dispatchable work; do not implement a gate from it.
- **Hot-file serialization for the claimant**: `es.ts` is shared with the queued #3875/#3810/#3845 family; `de.ts` with #3919/#3920/#3876. Re-read claims at claim time and serialize behind any in-flight claim on those files.
- **Dedup**: #3878 (ellipsis glyph split — held, distinct), #3844 (closed via PR #3874).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

## Adjudication (triage, 2026-08-09) — the scope split is the ruling, ⛔ do not widen it

**Queueable scope is the two typo groups ONLY:**

1. **es `Done`** — three sites read `Listo`, `grid.bulk.done` reads **`Hecho`** (`es.ts:107/:174/:316/:759` as cited; re-derive the line numbers from the tree, they are 15 days old). Same context, no grammatical divergence. The 2:1 majority value `Listo` is the one already chosen for `common.done`.
2. **de `Loading...`** — `common.loading` reads `Wird geladen...` (`de.ts:69`), `detail.loading` reads **`Laden...`** (`:806`). Same string, same context.

⛔ **The 281/164 denominator is documentation, NOT work.** It stays on the card. Triage: *"a same-en-same-translation gate would emit 164 false reds … do not implement a gate from it."* If you find yourself writing a lint rule, a script, or a test that asserts "same en implies same translation", you have left the fence — **stop and report**.

⛔ **Also out of scope: `#3878`'s ellipsis-glyph split.** The card mentions in passing that `Loading…` (U+2026) has three de spellings and two ko spellings. That is a *different, still-held* card. Fix the two ASCII `Loading...` values named above and leave every U+2026 variant alone.

## What makes this worth an agent rather than a sed

The only real risk is over-reach. 58% of shared English strings in this repo are **deliberately** translated differently per key — ru `Delete` is `Удаление` (noun, an activity-feed event type) in one place and `Удалить` (verb) in others; ja `Clear` is `選択解除` for `grid.bulkClear`. So "make identical English identical" is exactly the wrong instinct here, and the card exists partly to record that. Change **two values**. Before each one, satisfy yourself the two sites really are the same context — and say in the report how you checked, not just that you did.

If either value has already been corrected since 2026-08-08, that half is a with-evidence no-op: report it as such rather than manufacturing a diff. `premise_still_valid: false` is a legitimate delivery.

## ACCEPT — PR #5971 (R35, `domain:ui`)

Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report's self-description.

**Checklist:** draft ✅ · base `main` ✅ · `Part of #3880` first line — **correct, not a shortfall** (two of three halves are undelivered by design) ✅ · 3 files (`locales/es.ts`, `residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx`, changeset), fence honoured, `de.ts` read but never written ✅ · changeset `patch` for `@object-ui/i18n` ✅ · reverse-verified with a predicted-RED/observed-RED mutation and a proven restore ✅ · ⛔ no "same en implies same translation" gate anywhere in the diff ✅.

### ⚠️ First: my dispatch word was wrong, and you were right to stop rather than pick a side

I wrote that #3878 was *"a separate, still-held card"* and told you to fix the two ASCII `Loading...` values **and** leave every U+2026 variant alone. **Those two clauses name the same empty set.** #3878 landed as PR #4378 and converged all ten packs on U+2026, so there is no ASCII pair left to fix and the keys I fenced *in* are the ones I fenced *out*.

Verified independently before writing this, with control probes so the zero counts:

```
ASCII '...' inside any locale value on origin/main   0
control A — regex matches a synthetic "Loading..."   1  (so the pattern works)
control B — 'Wird geladen' in de.ts                  6  (so the path is right)
ellipsis-glyph-3878.test.ts present on main          yes
```

The cause is mine and it is the same failure class I corrected in four inherited notes at the top of this very round: I ran the stale-premise check on the **action** face and on the blocker cards, but took triage's 2026-08-09 sibling-card reference at face value without asking whether #3878 had since landed. A referenced sibling card is a card reference and gets the same re-read as a `Blocked-by:`. Recorded in the seat post.

**Reporting the conflict instead of resolving it silently was the correct delivery.** Either silent resolution would have been defensible-looking and wrong.

### Spot-checks

I re-measured the load-bearing claims rather than relaying them — and my own first probe was a false negative worth recording:

| claim | my reading |
|---|---|
| no ASCII `...` remains in any pack | ✅ 0, control-probed both directions |
| `Laden…` ×2 in de (`detail.loading`, `report.loading`) | ✅ de.ts **lines 868 and 2604** |
| `Hecho` was the lone es outlier pre-merge | ✅ exactly 1 occurrence in `es.ts` on `main` |

⚠️ My first `Laden…` probe anchored on a single quote and read **0** — `de.ts` mixes `'` and `"` and both those values use `"`. A counter-probe caught it. Flagging because it is the same wrong-anchor shape your report records against itself, and it would have had me wrongly doubt your table.

### The part that earns the ACCEPT

The risk on this card was never the edit; it was **over-reach**, on a card whose own subject is that 58% of shared `en` strings diverge on purpose. Three independent discriminators, any of which could have stopped it — byte-identical `en` values found by grouping rather than grepping a spelling; all four call sites read at the site and shown to be the same dialog-footer control; and **nine other packs unanimous**, which is the check that separates this group from the card's own counter-examples where the split *is* visible in the data.

Best single move: **testing a hypothesis that would have justified leaving `Hecho` alone** — the `Hecho`/`Deshecho` pairing — and refuting it on mechanism (`undonePrefix` is a result-line status at `BulkActionDialog.tsx:461`; the button's real counterpart `grid.bulk.undo` is the verb `Deshacer`). Also correct: the majority is **3:1, not the 2:1** the 2026-08-09 adjudication assumed, measured rather than inherited.

The pin change is a strengthening, not a loosening: the test had recorded this value as an *example of deliberate divergence*, so re-valuing it alone would have left a now-false note standing. Rewriting it to keep the history and the still-genuine `Pending`/zh row, and pinning all four `Done` values as one, means the outlier cannot regrow.

### Your open question — PM ruling: **A, #3880 stays open**

Its own triage ruled the denominator half *"knowledge, not dispatchable work"* and said explicitly it stays on the card. Closing it would leave the 164-false-reds finding with no addressable home — the exact re-implementation risk the card exists to prevent.

But an open card that is *purely* a record should not keep advertising itself as work. So, at landing: `pm:dispatched` comes off and the card is left carrying `domain:ui` with no pm-state — which is sweep case ③, so the triage Routine picks it up on its next hourly round. **Routing note for triage: the right grade is `tracking`** (the sweep excludes it by design, which is what a pure record needs). ⛔ Not applying that label here — grading is not this seat's to produce.

### #5972

Well-formed, unassigned, `domain:ui` with no pm-state so it is sweep-visible, and it re-frames the problem rather than re-filing the dead one. Its sequencing point is the right one and I am not overruling it: decide whether `approvalsInbox.loadingMore`'s **`en`** value should be its own string *before* converging translations, since changing it moves the key out of the group and makes nine packs follow.

### Landing

Not governed (`packages/i18n/**` + a test + a changeset — no path hit). So: ready → merge queue **once every check is green**, not the required subset. `mergeable_state` read `unstable` at 5 minutes, which is checks still running; gates get read **by name, once**, at ~11 minutes after this PR's own run `started_at`. I will not enqueue before that reading.

> 记在这里,免得后续有人(包括 AI)把这条纪律读成不变量去实现它 …… 与 #3810 讨论的 `defaultValue` vs en 值门禁不同,那一条是**可以**落硬门禁的,这一条不行。
